description: Run a raw SoQL query against any Montgomery County, MD open-data resource (data.montgomerycountymd.gov) by its Socrata id (8-char like "icn6-v9z3"). Full SoQL: where/select/group/order/limit/offset. Use montgomery_datasets to find a resource id, or montgomery_recent for the common ones.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

name: montgomery_query
